rules.title: KVM host received package updates recently
rules.rationale: QEMU, libvirt and kernel updates fix guest-to-host escape and privilege-escalation flaws. Package database age is a proxy for patch level.

mitigation.summary: Apply distribution security updates and restart affected QEMU processes (or live-migrate guests).
steps: Reboot or restart guests to load patched QEMU

rules.limitations: Uses package database timestamps, not per-CVE evaluation.

rules.title: Host OS release is within vendor security support
rules.rationale: Unsupported releases stop receiving security fixes for the kernel, QEMU and libvirt.

mitigation.summary: Upgrade to a supported release.
steps: Plan host upgrade with guest evacuation

rules.title: sVirt confinement is active (SELinux/AppArmor enforcing)
rules.rationale: sVirt confines each QEMU process so a compromised guest cannot access other guests' disks or the host.

mitigation.summary: Keep security_driver enabled and SELinux enforcing / AppArmor enabled.
steps: setenforce 1 and set SELINUX=enforcing (or enable AppArmor)

rules.title: No unauthenticated or plain-TCP libvirt listener
rules.rationale: libvirt API access is equivalent to root on the host; plain TCP exposes it to the network.

mitigation.summary: Disable listen_tcp / the libvirtd-tcp socket; use TLS (16514) with client certificates or SSH.

rules.title: QEMU does not run as root
rules.rationale: QEMU running as root turns any device-emulation escape into full host compromise.

mitigation.summary: Set user/group in qemu.conf to the distribution's unprivileged account.

rules.title: Host VNC default is loopback-only or TLS-protected
rules.rationale: Unencrypted network VNC exposes guest consoles and keystrokes.

mitigation.summary: Keep vnc_listen on 127.0.0.1 (tunnel over SSH) or enable vnc_tls with certificates.

rules.title: QEMU seccomp sandbox is not disabled
rules.rationale: The seccomp sandbox limits the system calls a compromised QEMU process can make.

mitigation.summary: Remove seccomp_sandbox = 0 from qemu.conf.

rules.title: Host boots with UEFI Secure Boot
rules.rationale: Secure Boot protects the host kernel and boot chain.

mitigation.summary: Enable UEFI Secure Boot (with signed kernel modules).

rules.title: Host firewall service is active
rules.rationale: A host firewall limits exposure of libvirt, VNC/SPICE and management services.

mitigation.summary: Enable firewalld, nftables or ufw with a restrictive policy.

rules.title: SSH does not allow root password login
rules.rationale: Direct root password login enables brute force against the most privileged account.

mitigation.summary: Set PermitRootLogin no (or prohibit-password) and use named accounts with sudo.

rules.title: SSH password authentication is disabled
rules.rationale: Key-based authentication resists password guessing and credential reuse.

mitigation.summary: Set PasswordAuthentication no after deploying keys.

rules.title: libvirt/kvm group membership is reviewed

check.guidance: Members of the libvirt group can manage all guests and are effectively root; confirm only approved administrators

rules.rationale: libvirt group membership grants root-equivalent control.

mitigation.summary: Remove unapproved members.

rules.title: Nested virtualization is disabled
rules.rationale: Nested virtualization increases hypervisor attack surface.

mitigation.summary: Disable the kvm_intel/kvm_amd nested parameter unless required.

rules.title: Guest uses dynamic sVirt labeling
rules.rationale: seclabel type='none' or relabel='no' removes the guest's confinement.

mitigation.summary: Remove static/none seclabel overrides from the domain XML.

rules.title: Guest console is not exposed on the network
rules.rationale: Network-exposed VNC/SPICE allows console access and keystroke capture.

mitigation.summary: Bind graphics to 127.0.0.1 or a UNIX socket and tunnel access.

rules.title: No host device passthrough
rules.rationale: PCI/USB passthrough gives the guest direct hardware (DMA) access (record exceptions for GPU/AI workloads).

mitigation.summary: Remove passthrough devices or document the exception; ensure IOMMU is enabled.

rules.title: No network-backed serial consoles
rules.rationale: TCP/telnet serial consoles are unauthenticated access paths into the guest.

mitigation.summary: Use pty/unix consoles accessed through virsh console.

rules.title: No USB redirection devices
rules.rationale: USB redirection lets console clients attach devices to the guest.

mitigation.summary: Remove redirdev elements.

rules.title: Guest interfaces use an anti-spoofing nwfilter
rules.rationale: Without nwfilter (e.g. clean-traffic) a guest can spoof MAC/IP/ARP on shared bridges.

mitigation.summary: Add <filterref filter='clean-traffic'/> to interfaces.

rules.title: Guest uses UEFI Secure Boot
rules.rationale: Secure Boot blocks unsigned bootloaders in the guest.

mitigation.summary: Use OVMF secure boot firmware.

rules.title: Guest has a virtual TPM
rules.rationale: A vTPM (swtpm) enables measured boot and disk encryption in the guest.

mitigation.summary: Add an emulated TPM 2.0 device.

rules.title: No snapshots older than 7 days
rules.rationale: Aged snapshots grow overlays and are not backups.

mitigation.summary: Delete or merge aged snapshots after confirming backups.

rules.title: Virtual network is not in 'open' forward mode
rules.rationale: Forward mode 'open' installs no libvirt firewall rules for the network.

mitigation.summary: Use nat/route with host firewall policy, or document the external firewall.
